requirements.text: A named element has a string that stores its name.
A Database has a String that stores its SGBD name.
A relational database schema can have a table.
A Column has a string to store its datatype and a string to store its default value.
A Database may contain any number of Tables.
A Table is associated with exactly one Database.
A table can have any number of columns as keys.
In a Relational Database Schema, a Column has exactly one Table as its owner.
